description: Evidence manifest for proving contract/platform extraction packages were copied into their target repositories without provider-private leakage.
rules: compatible and each repository package_compatible must be true
each repository extracted value must be true
issues must be an empty list
source_sha256 and destination_sha256 must match for every copied entry unless a supported transform is declared
supported transforms are explicitly declared per entry; current supported transform type is python_import_rewrite
source_sha256 and destination_sha256 values must be 64 lowercase hex characters
future_path must be safe relative path
when the extraction manifest is supplied, every required manifest entry must have matching evidence
each repository must carry an import_boundary block recording what the staged tree was checked against; a run that reports validity without one validated only its own shape
violation_count must not exceed the manifest governance staged_import_violation_baseline for that lane; the baseline ratchets down only
violations are recorded even when within baseline, so "checked and found none" and "never looked" stay distinguishable in the record
notes: This validator checks captured extraction metadata only. It does not create repositories, push commits, copy files, hash file bytes, or inspect remote Git hosts.
